title: [AUG-73] RCA: Incomplete FE audit — agent scoped to single category instead of full brandbook
why_we_need_this: During AUG-71 (Major FE audit), the agent read the full brandbook (~480 lines covering 12+ rule categories: border-radius, colors, typography, spacing, shadows, dark mode, accessibility, responsive breakpoints, etc.) but then built an execution plan covering only border-radius and hover transforms. The task was marked to_review as if complete, when only ~15% of the brandbook was actually audited. Color violations were caught only after the user asked a follow-up question. This represents a systematic failure in Step 4 (trajectory preparation) — the agent collapsed a multi-category audit into a single-category fix without acknowledging the scope reduction.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Root cause documented: identify why Step 4 narrowed scope (cognitive shortcut — picked the most visually obvious violation category and treated it as the whole task)

2. Prevention rule added to Jarvis assignee constraints or project-context:
   - When a task says "audit ALL" or "check EVERY", Step 4 MUST produce a checklist that maps 1:1 to every section/category in the reference document (brandbook, spec, etc.)
   - The execution trajectory must explicitly list each category with a pass/fail placeholder
   - Categories with zero findings must still appear as "audited — compliant" rather than being silently skipped
   - The agent must not mark to_review until every category in the checklist has a recorded result

3. Verification gate: before calling update_task_status → to_review on any audit-type task, the agent must compare the number of brandbook/spec sections against the number of sections covered in findings — if coverage is below 100%, the agent must either continue or explicitly flag partial coverage to the user

4. Apply these rules retroactively: reopen AUG-71 and complete the remaining brandbook categories (colors, typography, spacing, shadows, dark mode completeness, accessibility, responsive breakpoints)
important_constraints: This is a process improvement task, not a code task. The deliverable is updated agent instructions and a completed re-audit, not just a written document.
